If you are a Data Specialist professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will help ensure the availability, consistency, and effective use of operational data by developing reporting solutions, supporting data quality initiatives, and transforming business requirements into meaningful insights. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance decision-making, improve operational performance, and contribute to digital transformation initiatives across the organization.
 In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be
Analyze and interpret operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand processes, reporting needs, and performance objectives.
Identify relevant data sources and contribute to defining requirements for data utilization and reporting.
Ensure consistent application of business definitions, metrics, and key performance indicators.
Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions using platforms such as Power BI, DOMO, or similar Business Intelligence tools.
Translate business requirements into user-friendly and effective reporting solutions.
Support the standardization and continuous improvement of operational reporting practices.
Monitor and improve the accuracy, integrity, and quality of data used in reporting and analysis.
Investigate data discrepancies and collaborate with relevant teams to implement corrective actions.
Contribute to Data Governance and Data Quality initiatives and standards.
Document data sources, business rules, reporting logic, and analytical methodologies.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, IT, and Business Intelligence teams to improve reporting and analytics capabilities.
Support testing and validation activities for new data sources, integrations, and data models.
Provide guidance to users regarding reporting tools and interpretation of data insights.
Participate in digital transformation and process improvement initiatives.
Help identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practices in data management and reporting.
Support compliance with company policies related to information security, ethics, health and safety, environmental standards, and international trade compliance requirements.
 Who You Are
 You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, adapting your approach to different stakeholder needs. You use data and sound judgment to solve problems, identify opportunities, and drive effective decisions. You prioritize work effectively, remain focused on delivering high-quality results, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, systems, and outcomes.
 For This Role, You Will Need
Experience working with data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or a related field.
Working knowledge of data analytics concepts and reporting methodologies.
Experience using Power BI, DOMO, or similar Business Intelligence and visualization tools.
Knowledge of SQL and data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Strong English language communication skills, both written and verbal.
Commitment to data accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement
 Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart
Experience working with ERP systems, particularly SAP.
Exposure to data governance, data quality, or master data management practices.
Experience supporting operational reporting and business performance analysis.
Familiarity with digital transformation, process optimization, or automation initiatives.
Ability to create clear documentation for data sources, reporting logic, and business requirements.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional global teams.
 Our Culture And Commitment To You
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives--because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
